_comment: This file lists the kinds of file a Godot project can hold. Chimera's New Project window is built from it.

slots.title: Game
slots.help: The game's .pck file, which an exported Godot game keeps beside its executable (Game.exe and Game.pck). A game exported as a single file has the .pck inside its executable: then give the executable (.exe or .x86_64) instead.

slots.title: Other files beside the game
slots.help: Files the game opens from the folder its executable is in, under the names it asks for: a second .pck it loads (downloadable content, a mod), or data it reads beside itself. A game that loads nothing else needs nothing here.

slots.title: Save data
slots.help: What the game keeps in user:// (its saves and settings), as Emulator > Export Save Data wrote it: each file under its own name, or the .zip the export makes of several. They are put in user:// before the game starts, so the game finds them as its own. A file of the export that was in a folder of user:// goes back in that folder only from the .zip.
